svg.aria-description: Tracking database: 5 tables, 4 relations. 5 tables and the 4 foreign keys between them, imported from SQL.
svg.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: Tracking database
svg.desc: Tracking database: 5 tables, 4 relations. 5 tables and the 4 foreign keys between them, imported from SQL. Tables: - merchants - id BIGSERIAL (primary key) - name TEXT - api_token TEXT (unique) - created_at TIMESTAMPTZ - shipments - id BIGSERIAL (primary key) - merchant_id BIGINT (foreign key) - reference TEXT - label_key TEXT (nullable) - created_at TIMESTAMPTZ - parcels - id BIGSERIAL (primary key) - shipment_id BIGINT (foreign key) - code TEXT (unique) - weight_grams INTEGER - status TEXT - parcel_events - id BIGSERIAL (primary key) - parcel_id BIGINT (foreign key) - carrier TEXT - kind TEXT - happened_at TIMESTAMPTZ - webhooks - id BIGSERIAL (primary key) - merchant_id BIGINT (foreign key) - url TEXT - secret TEXT Relations: - shipments.merchant_id references merchants.id (many to one) - parcels.shipment_id references shipments.id (many to one) - parcel_events.parcel_id references parcels.id (many to one) - webhooks.merchant_id references merchants.id (many to one)
